name: Effective Range / Proper Stable Sample Compression
details: Proposed bound for finite concept classes; not currently established here. Retaining all active-coordinate instances does not give their labels to an unlabeled decoder, so the former least-consistent-member construction does not define the claimed scheme. The corresponding labeled argument remains valid. A proper stable unlabeled replacement proof or counterexample is required; no refutation is claimed. The benchmark gap below remains valid independently of the proposed universal bound.
witness_verification: For the $n$ singletons together with the empty concept, effective range is $n$, while proper stable sample-compression size is 1.
